description.narrative: The most significant expected Project-level outcome is the increase in access to finance for MSMEs, including WMSMEs in Tchad. This will help address the large MSME finance gap in Chad valued at US$1.5 billion, equivalent to over 14% of GDP. Beyond the Project-level outcome, IFC anticipates that the Project, together with other projects with CBI subsidiaries in the region, will promote greater market competitiveness in MSME lending across the financial sector via demonstration and replication effects.

The proposed investment consists of a 5-year senior loan of up to US$10 million, including mobilization of up to US$5 million to Coris Bank International Tchad (CBI TD or the Bank), the third largest bank in Chad. The facility will contribute to increase access to longer-term financing for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSME) with at least 15 percent of loan proceeds dedicated to women-owned/led MSMEs (WMSMEs) in Tchad (the Project). Subject to further approvals, the Project will be processed under IFCs MSME Finance Platform (the Platform) which is supported by a pooled first loss guarantee provided by the International Development Association Private Sector Window Blended Finance Facility (IDA20 PSW BFF) allocated to the SME Envelope under the Platform.
